purpose: 2026-10-10 DFT-informed campaign, S4A-02-2p0, S4A-02-6p3, S4A-02-13p2, S4A-03-2p0, S4A-03-6p3, S4A-03-13p2, S4A-04-2p0, S4A-04-6p3, S4A-04-13p2, S4A-05-2p0, S4A-05-6p3, S4A-05-13p2, S4A-06-2p0, S4A-06-6p3, S4A-06-13p2. Generated by analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/make_campaign_configs.py from campaign_matrix.json (entries verbatim, matrix order; A50 batch). Design: analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/CAMPAIGN_DESIGN.md.
global_rules: Sequential only: python scripts/run_campaign.py <plan> (C10 plans refuse --workers != 1). Every launch counts, failed or not. Hard cap 200: config/solver.yaml max_launches 260 (= 60 used before C10 + 200) and a C10 label counter (c10_* run IDs in RUN_INDEX <= 200) in run_campaign.py.

run_campaign.py (C10 plans) never re-launches an entry whose label already has a RUN_INDEX row, from this or any other C10 plan (MIN10 vs stage plans): a successful earlier launch is reused, a failed one is reported; --retry ID spends a new (reserve) launch on purpose.
Model file for every entry: $env:IWO_MODEL_FILE = "config/iwo_material_model_v3.yaml" (V3 + the overrides = the same solver statements as V2 + the overrides, check_v3_equivalence.py).
After any code change: python analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/regress_all_decks.py must print "unexpected differences 0" before the next launch.

run_campaign.py records a failed launch and CONTINUES (this plan declares no gates); it stops automatically only at the launch budget / C10 cap. Every stop rule below is applied manually: the main session reads the state-only results/campaigns/<plan>.json (full record sealed under results/sealed/campaigns) and decides.
stop_rules: Register step 6, S4a batch 1 of 3 (A50): candidates S4A-02..S4A-06, each at 2.0 (1600 s), 6.3 (2000 s) and 13.2 nm (3100 s); 15 launches.

State-only (A41 (e) inventory rule, A49 (d)): each run is appended to config/sealed_runs.json right after this invocation, before any regression check or re-invocation; console and results/campaigns/<plan>.json carry state only; the full record is sealed under results/sealed/campaigns. S4a curves are read only through the frozen profile_s4s5.py (429b3a3f): profile_n per completed candidate triple after each batch; surrogate (S4a abort, B3) on the complete inventory of 15 (S4A-01 = run_0061 / run_0068 / run_0069).

Every launch counts; a failed or timed-out launch is recorded invalid and kept; no repeat, no --retry, no repair without a logged decision (the six PA-19 v3 repairs stay reserved); an unknown candidate keeps the S4a abort UNRESOLVED (B3).

After S4a (design l.325): best sqrt(J) > 0.30 dec AND >= 80 % of the 15 candidates with a same-sign 6.3 nm on-state error -> skip S4b, run S4c on the best (route disabled until the PA-18 wrapper is registered), go to S5, report the shared model as failed; no per-film rescue parameters, ever. Otherwise S4b (template) under its own stop rule.
stop_rules_enforced_by: main session (manual); run_campaign.py enforces the launch budget and C10 cap, refuses runnable=false plans and applies the state-only surface (scripts/campaign_sealed.py); this plan declares no gates
register_amendment: A50 (2026-10-15; S4a execution entries of form N under the A49 decision, route plans, S4a gate; no Codex review, D-63): invoke only after A49 and A50 and their decision rows are logged, with the go for THIS launch (Claude under D-59), immediately after prelaunch_gate_c10_g.py has exited 0 naming this plan
launch_command: $env:IWO_MODEL_FILE = "config/iwo_material_model_v3.yaml"; <project venv python> scripts/run_campaign.py config/campaign_C10_S4a_b1.json   (PowerShell, package root, immediately after prelaunch_gate_c10_g.py exited 0 naming this plan; no --retry; IWO_ATLAS_VIEWERS unset)
